scientific_facts_for_ui.fact_1: NASA's MOXIE device requires an internal heater to reach 800°C to separate oxygen from carbon dioxide.
scientific_facts_for_ui.fact_2: The Martian atmosphere consists of 95% toxic carbon dioxide, and night temperatures in Jezero Crater drop to -60°C.
scientific_facts_for_ui.fact_3: Without continuous heating, water pipes freeze and batteries lose efficiency quickly in the harsh Martian cold.
